title: Longest Subarray of Equal Elements After One Replacement
statement:
Given an array of N integers, you may change at most one element to any value. Find the length of the longest contiguous subarray where all elements are equal after this at-most-one replacement.

Use a sliding window: maintain a window where the count of the most-frequent element allows the rest to be filled by at most one replacement.
inputFormat:
Line 1: a single integer N.
Line 2: N space-separated integers.
outputFormat: A single integer: the maximum length of the subarray.

examples.explanation: Replace the single 2 at index 3 with 1. Now the entire array is [1,1,1,1,1,1], length 6.
Replace the 1 with 3. Entire array becomes [3,3,3,3,3], length 5.
